arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-ledger-release.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch feat/membership-registry-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
cd "$work"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "73af059c9a552227ecbdbd5b38757178d82015e1"
git --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; fs=["scripts/member_groups.py","scripts/safe_runtime.py","scripts/leads_operational_report.py","scripts/deploy_project_only.py"]; [ast.parse(Path(f).read_text()) for f in fs]; print("LEDGER_SYNTAX_OK",len(fs))'
node --check ecosystem.config.js
echo TESTED_RELEASE_245_PASS
